method: AST import scan plus targeted execution-flow inspection on clean deployment worktrees

fixed_authority_edits.main.py: remove routing preload/error handler, cutover and gate routers, and write-freeze middleware; keep local analysis for the eleven exclusive sources
fixed_authority_edits.routers/ai_match.py: resolve the retained CompositeMatching directly and remove core_read fallback branches
fixed_authority_edits.services/daily_match_report.py: compose Core feed with locally owned exclusive sources directly, without routing lookup
fixed_authority_edits.services/document_store.py: return the configured CoreDocuments authority directly while retaining owner validation
fixed_authority_edits.services/school_store.py: return CoreSchools directly; retain manual refresh, dashboard and alerts

functionality_gate.services/saved_search_runner.py: preserve until Portfolio inbox turns Core saved_search.matches events into the existing user notification contract, or an explicit product decision retires those alerts
functionality_gate.verified_current_gap: under core_primary the local runner already disables itself; Portfolio integration inbox records arbitrary events and validates document.changed but does not create saved-search notifications

fixed_authority_edits.backend/services/profile_sync.py: always provision/deliver the Core profile snapshot; remove routing flip after ACK
fixed_authority_edits.backend/services/exclusions_sync.py: deliver exclusions to the already linked Core profile directly
fixed_authority_edits.backend/services/matching/feedback.py: remove the routing assertion but retain feedback authority and local overlay until its separate gate closes
fixed_authority_edits.backend/tasks/fetch_tasks.py: remove the local embedding dispatch after harvest
fixed_authority_edits.backend/tasks/scraping_tasks.py: remove the local embedding dispatch after harvest
fixed_authority_edits.backend/models/__init__.py: remove the historical routing model export

functionality_gates.daily_and_watchlist_digests: retain until Core matching notifications are materialized or explicitly retired; both tasks currently gate Core profiles out and read local match_results
functionality_gates.match_result_overlay: retain MatchResultService, applications/local.py and feedback state because CoreMatching and the watchlist/application state machine still call them
functionality_gates.match_event_delivery: Core emits match.evaluated and the BFF stores the receipt, but integration_inbox only materializes saved_search.matches notifications
functionality_gates.watchlist_health: retain independently of matching; it monitors school collectors and user preferences

conclusion: The routing model can be removed only after every direct consumer above is changed. Notification and match-result overlays have independent live responsibilities and are outside a blanket rollback cleanup.
